full_prompt_en: A square street-art photograph shows a life-size monochrome drawing of a young traveler sitting sideways on a plain tan wall. The figure wears a rounded soft cap over dark curly hair, a scarf tied at the neck, a loose worn jacket, rolled trousers, and heavy lace-up boots. One knee is drawn high near the chest, the other leg drops toward the lower left, and one hand is raised near the mouth holding a slim cigarette. The face turns left in alert profile, with finely shaded cheek and nose. The other hand slips into a jacket pocket. There is no painted chair: the seated pose is suggested by a dark gray patch beneath the hips and a larger rough patch at the back, making the drawn body seem to occupy a shallow niche in the wall. Dense black and gray hatch marks model the folds of fabric, boot leather, hands, and tousled hair, while broad dark washes supply shadow. The warm beige wall remains visible throughout the drawing and fills the empty left side and upper corners. Its paper-like wrinkles, seams, and scuffs cross behind and through the image, adding a physical surface separate from the drawn figure. The photograph is frontal and evenly lit, so the illusion can be read at once without a theatrical spotlight. There are no legible words or signs. The composition places the figure just right of center and lets the extended boot anchor the lower left. The mood feels observant and slightly melancholy, with an ordinary pause rendered in meticulous draftsmanship and made surprising by its placement directly on an unadorned wall.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形街头艺术摄影呈现一名与真人等大的黑白绘制年轻旅人，侧坐在一面朴素赭色墙上。人物戴圆软帽，露出深色卷发，颈间系围巾，穿宽松磨旧外套、翻边长裤和厚重系带靴。一侧膝盖高抬到胸前，另一条腿向左下垂，一只手举到嘴边，夹着细烟。面孔警觉地向左侧转，脸颊与鼻梁由精细明暗塑成。另一只手插在外套口袋里。画中没有椅子：臀下的深灰色块与背后较大的粗糙灰块暗示坐姿，使绘制身体仿佛占据墙上的浅壁龛。密集黑灰排线塑造布料褶皱、靴子皮革、双手和蓬乱头发，宽阔深色擦痕提供阴影。暖米色墙面穿插于整幅画并填满左侧与上方空处。纸张般的皱纹、接缝与擦伤从画后和人物中穿过，增添与绘制形体不同的真实表面。摄影正面取景且光照均匀，因此无须戏剧聚光即可读懂错觉。没有可读文字或标牌。构图把人物放在中央稍右，伸出的靴子压住左下。气氛富观察感且略带忧郁，把平常的停顿以细密素描表现，又因其直接位于空白墙上而显得意外。
style_prompt_en: Monochrome figurative street drawing uses dense charcoal-like hatching and broad gray washes on a warm, unpainted wall. Precise contour work and layered crosshatching give cloth, hair, skin, and leather different weight, while darker patches imply cast shadow and shallow depth. The wall's wrinkles, scuffs, and uneven plaster remain openly visible, so the artwork reads as an intervention on a real surface rather than a clean illustration page. Frontal documentary photography records the drawn illusion with even natural light and little color beyond beige, black, and gray. Leave generous bare wall around the rendered form; careful tonal modeling can then make an ordinary gesture appear unexpectedly present in the space. The appeal comes from tactile linework, weathered support, and a poised balance between illusion and exposed material.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白具象街头绘画在暖色原墙面上使用密集炭笔般排线和宽阔灰色擦染。精确轮廓与层叠交叉线让布、发、肤与皮革各有重量，较深的色块则暗示投影与浅纵深。墙面的皱纹、擦伤和不平灰泥坦然可见，使作品像对真实表面的介入，而非洁净插画纸面。正面纪实摄影以均匀自然光记录绘制错觉，色彩几乎只有米色、黑色与灰色。让成形人物周围保有大量裸墙；细致明暗塑造便能使平常动作意外地出现在空间中。魅力来自可触的线工、经风化的承载面，以及幻觉与裸露材料之间端正的平衡。
theme_en: A monochrome drawn traveler sits and smokes on a wrinkled tan wall
theme_zh: 一名黑白绘制的旅人坐在起皱赭色墙面上抽烟
name: Levalet
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
